A '''skirmish''' took place in [[Meliflar Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Mendenbatt system/Legends|Mendenbatt system]], in [[44 ABY]]. After forcing the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] to flee from [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]], [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] tracked her&mdash;using a [[blood trail]] established by Luke&mdash;to Meliflar Station. Abeloth had put [[Fala (Human)|Fala]], the daughter of the station's leader, [[Hallaf]], into a subconscious state, and ordered that the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] at the station set up explosives that would detonate upon the arrival of Khai and the Skywalkers in their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''. However, after Abeloth left the station, the crew of smugglers decided that they would rather capture the ship. Led by [[Cardya]], they mutinied and put Hallaf and Fala in the station's [[Prison/Legends|brig]], and then set up an ambush for Khai and the Jedi.

Upon the Jedi's arrival, a [[Lightfight|firefight]] ensued, although Khai and the Skywalkers were able to overcome the smugglers' defenses and force them to cease fire. Cardya was brought forward and she explained their situation to the Jedi, who freed Fala from her trance and continued tracking Abeloth to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].
